mods.description: Makes it easier to see what type of axolotl is in your inventory

releases.notes:
**AxolotlViewer 1.0.3 is now here!**
This version updates AxolotlViewer to support 1.19.

The JAR file below has been tested and is confirmed to work from 1.17.1 to 1.19-rc1.

### 🔨 Minor Changes
* Added support for 1.19
* Updated mod icon (39af20c)

### 📝 Notes
- [fabric-api](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) is required for loading resources.

[Don't like using GitHub releases? Download the mod from Modrinth!](https://modrinth.com/mod/axolotlviewer)

releases.notes:
**AxolotlViewer 1.0.1 is now here!**
This release contains the following changes:
- Improves the way that the bucket item models are loaded
- Fixes potential compatibility issues with other mods

If you have any problems, please open an [issue](https://github.com/cbyrneee/AxolotlViewer/issues/new).
[You can also download the mod from Modrinth!](https://modrinth.com/mod/axolotlviewer)

*Note: AxolotlViewer requires the Fabric API for loading mod textures*
